title: Scalp coverage and hair drape improved; facial seams remain
notes: Leading-edge fibers cover the bare scalp; hair ends retain gravity-led drape and the collar sits higher. Remaining: visible eyelid seams, overly simplified nose and lips, rigid collar leaves, and stylized rather than reference-level likeness.
review_method: Manual visual review of actual Eevee render; subjective, not measured likeness.
